### Sex

```{r}
sem_model_sex = '# Latent variables
  AD_pathology =~ ptau181_residual + ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new
  Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
  Cognition =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

  # Covariances
  meta_roi_inv ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
  zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
  zscore_interm_sevlt_inv ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
  zscore_fas_inv ~~ zscore_animal_naming_inv
  ab_suvr ~~ ab_pos_new

  AD_pathology ~~ Neurodegeneration
  Neurodegeneration ~~ Cognition

  # Structural regressions
  AD_pathology ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
  Neurodegeneration ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
  Cognition ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + lang_Spanish + age_z + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4'

# Free structural paths; loadings equal
fit_sex_free = sem(
  sem_model_sex,
  data = sem_data_sdoh,
  group = "sex",
  group.equal = c("loadings"),
  missing = "fiml",
  fixed.x = TRUE)

# Constrain structural paths 
fit_sex_equal = sem(
  sem_model_sex,
  data = sem_data_sdoh,
  group = "sex",
  group.equal = c("loadings", "regressions"),
  missing = "fiml",
  fixed.x = TRUE)

# Chi-square difference test: do the structural paths differ by sex?
lavTestLRT(fit_sex_free, fit_sex_equal)

# Model summaries
summary(fit_sex_free, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
summary(fit_sex_equal, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

```


### Race


```{r}
sem_model_race = '# Latent variables
  AD_pathology =~ ptau181_residual + ptau217_ab42_residual + ab_suvr + ab_pos_new
  Neurodegeneration =~ nfl_residual + meta_roi_inv + hippcampul_residual_inv
  Cognition =~ zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv + zscore_interm_sevlt_inv + zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv + zscore_delay_svelt_inv + zscore_wms_digit_inv + zscore_trail_ab_inv + zscore_fas_inv + zscore_animal_naming_inv

  # Covariances
  meta_roi_inv ~~ hippcampul_residual_inv
  zscore_interm_wms_mem_inv ~~ zscore_delay_wms_mem_inv
  zscore_interm_sevlt_inv ~~ zscore_delay_svelt_inv
  zscore_fas_inv ~~ zscore_animal_naming_inv
  ab_suvr ~~ ab_pos_new

  AD_pathology ~~ Neurodegeneration
  Neurodegeneration ~~ Cognition

  # Structural regressions
  AD_pathology ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
  Neurodegeneration ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4
  Cognition ~ prs_z_prscsx + cogd_sem + apoe4 + SDoH + age_z + sex + PC1 + PC2 + PC3 + PC4'


# Free structural paths across race groups, but keep factor loadings equal
fit_race_free = sem(
  sem_model_race, 
  data = sem_data_sdoh, 
  group = "race", 
  group.equal = c("loadings"), 
  missing = "fiml", 
  fixed.x = TRUE)

# Constrain structural paths to be equal across race groups
fit_race_equal = sem(
  sem_model_race, 
  data = sem_data_sdoh, 
  group = "race", 
  group.equal = c("loadings", "regressions"), 
  missing = "fiml", 
  fixed.x = TRUE)

# Chi-square difference test: do the structural paths differ by race?
lavTestLRT(fit_race_free, fit_race_equal)

# Model summaries
summary(fit_race_free, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
summary(fit_race_equal, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)

# Test one perdictor at a time: PRS
fit_prs = sem(
  sem_model_race,
  data = sem_data_sdoh,
  group = "race",
  group.equal = c("loadings","regressions"),
  group.partial = c(
    "AD_pathology ~ prs_z_prscsx",
    "Neurodegeneration ~ prs_z_prscsx",
    "Cognition ~ prs_z_prscsx"),
  missing = "fiml", fixed.x = TRUE)

lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)


# APOE
fit_apoe = sem(
  sem_model_race,
  data = sem_data_sdoh,
  group = "race",
  group.equal = c("loadings","regressions"),
  group.partial = c(
    "AD_pathology ~ apoe4",
    "Neurodegeneration ~ apoe4",
    "Cognition ~ apoe4"),
  missing = "fiml", fixed.x = TRUE)

lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)


# CogDRisk
fit_cog = sem(

fit_apoe_neuro = sem(

fit_apoe_cog = sem(

lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_cog)


subset(
    standardizedSolution(fit_apoe_AD),
    op == "~" &
    lhs == "AD_pathology" &
    rhs == "apoe4")

```


### APOE effects


```{r}

# Pairwise test function for APOE -> AD pathology
pairwise_apoe_ad = function(dat, g1, g2, model = sem_model_race) {

  # keep only the two groups
  d = subset(dat, race %in% c(g1, g2))
  d$race = factor(d$race, levels = c(g1, g2))

  # model with APOE -> AD constrained equal across the 2 groups
  fit_equal = sem(
    model,
    data = d,
    group = "race",
    group.equal = c("loadings", "regressions"),
    missing = "fiml",
    fixed.x = TRUE
  )

  # model with APOE -> AD allowed to differ across the 2 groups
  fit_free = sem(
    model,
    data = d,
    group = "race",
    group.equal = c("loadings", "regressions"),
    group.partial = "AD_pathology ~ apoe4",
    missing = "fiml",
    fixed.x = TRUE
  )

  # likelihood ratio test
  lrt = lavTestLRT(fit_equal, fit_free)

  # standardized APOE -> AD estimates in the free model
  est = subset(
    standardizedSolution(fit_free),
    op == "~" & lhs == "AD_pathology" & rhs == "apoe4"
  )

  data.frame(
    comparison = paste(g1, "vs", g2),
    chisq_diff  = lrt[2, "Chisq diff"],
    df_diff     = lrt[2, "Df diff"],
    p_value     = lrt[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"],
    beta_g1     = est$est.std[est$group == 1],
    beta_g2     = est$est.std[est$group == 2]
  )
}


race_pairs = combn(c("NHW", "Black", "Hispanic"), 2, simplify = FALSE)

pairwise_results = do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(race_pairs, function(x) pairwise_apoe_ad(sem_data_sdoh, x[1], x[2]))
)

pairwise_results$p_adj = p.adjust(pairwise_results$p_value, method = "holm")
pairwise_results

```


```{r}
# Extract model fit for one lavaan object
fit_row = function(fit, model_name) {
  fm = fitMeasures(fit, c("chisq", "df", "tli", "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
  tibble(
    Model = model_name,
    X2    = unname(fm["chisq"]),
    df    = unname(fm["df"]),
    TLI   = unname(fm["tli"]),
    CFI   = unname(fm["cfi"]),
    RMSEA = unname(fm["rmsea"]),
    SRMR  = unname(fm["srmr"])
  )
}

# Add LRT stats to the second row of a two-model comparison
add_lrt = function(tbl, fit_free, fit_equal) {
  lrt = lavTestLRT(fit_free, fit_equal)

  tbl %>%
    mutate(
      Delta_X2 = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Chisq diff"])),
      Delta_df = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Df diff"])),
      p_LRT    = c(NA, unname(lrt[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]))
    )
}

pretty_tbl = function(x) {
  x %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
}


sex_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_sex_free,  "Free structural paths"),
  fit_row(fit_sex_equal, "Equal structural paths")
) %>%
  add_lrt(fit_sex_free, fit_sex_equal) %>%
  pretty_tbl()


race_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_race_free,  "Free structural paths"),
  fit_row(fit_race_equal, "Equal structural paths")
) %>%
  add_lrt(fit_race_free, fit_race_equal) %>%
  pretty_tbl()


race_pred_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_prs,  "PRS freed"),
  fit_row(fit_apoe, "APOE freed"),
  fit_row(fit_cog,  "CogD freed"),
  fit_row(fit_sdoh, "SDoH freed")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_X2 = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Chisq diff"])
    ),
    Delta_df = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Df diff"])
    ),
    p_LRT = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_prs)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_cog)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_sdoh)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"])
    )
  ) %>%
  pretty_tbl()


apoe_outcome_tbl = bind_rows(
  fit_row(fit_apoe_AD,    "APOE ~ Aβ/tau"),
  fit_row(fit_apoe_neuro, "APOE ~ Neurodegeneration"),
  fit_row(fit_apoe_cog,   "APOE ~ Cognition")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_X2 = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_AD)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_neuro)[2, "Chisq diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_cog)[2, "Chisq diff"])
    ),
    Delta_df = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_AD)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_neuro)[2, "Df diff"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_cog)[2, "Df diff"])
    ),
    p_LRT = c(
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_AD)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_neuro)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"]),
      unname(lavTestLRT(fit_race_equal, fit_apoe_cog)[2, "Pr(>Chisq)"])
    )
  ) %>%

pairwise_results_tbl = pairwise_results %>%
  select(-p_value) %>%
  pretty_tbl() %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Comparison = comparison,
    `ΔX2` = chisq_diff,
    `Δdf` = df_diff,
    `β2` = beta_g1,
    `β1` = beta_g2,
    `P-Value adj.` = p_adj)


sex_tbl2 = sex_tbl %>% mutate(Analysis = "Sex: Overall")
race_tbl2 = race_tbl %>% mutate(Analysis = "Race: Overall")
race_pred_tbl2 = race_pred_tbl %>% mutate(Analysis = "Race: Regression coefficients")
apoe_outcome_tbl2 = apoe_outcome_tbl %>% mutate(Analysis = "Race: APOE")

all_tbl = bind_rows(
  sex_tbl2,
  race_tbl2,
  race_pred_tbl2,
  apoe_outcome_tbl2
) %>%
  select(Analysis, everything()) 

all_tbl = all_tbl %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Analysis = Analysis,
    Model = Model,
    X2 = X2,
    df = df,
    TLI = TLI,
    CFI = CFI,
    RMSEA = RMSEA,
    SRMR = SRMR,
    `ΔX2` = `Delta_X2`,
    `Δdf` = `Delta_df`,
    `P-value adj.` = p_LRT
  )


```
